SYMPTOM: Undefined symbol `___isPlatformVersionAtLeast` when building whisper-rs 0.16.0 on macOS ARM64
CAUSE: whisper-rs 0.16.0 uses newer ggml-metal-device.m with @available() ObjC checks — emits ___isPlatformVersionAtLeast. Cargo doesn't auto-inject Apple Clang's libclang_rt like Xcode does.
FIX: In .cargo/config.toml:
  [target.aarch64-apple-darwin]
  rustflags = [
    "-C", "link-arg=-mmacosx-version-min=11.0",
    "-L", "/path/from/clang --print-runtime-dir",
    "-l", "static=clang_rt.osx",
  ]
PREVENT: Any whisper-rs upgrade may require this fix — check with `clang --print-runtime-dir` to find correct path
API CHANGE: 0.14.3→0.16.0 also changed segment API:
  OLD: state.full_get_segment_text(i) / full_get_segment_t0(i) / full_get_segment_t1(i)
  NEW: state.get_segment(i).unwrap().to_str() / .start_timestamp() / .end_timestamp()
  OLD: state.full_n_segments() returns Result<i32>
  NEW: returns c_int directly (no .unwrap_or needed)
